title: Helmet Inner Cap vs Balaclava: Which One for Indian Riders?
seo_title: Helmet Inner Cap vs Balaclava: Which One for Indian Riders?
seo_description: Helmet inner cap or balaclava? How they compare on heat, cold, sweat, helmet hygiene and fit, and which one suits your rides in India, season by season.
excerpt: A helmet inner cap and a balaclava both go under your helmet, but they do different jobs. Here is how to choose by season, ride length, helmet type and hygiene, for Indian riding.
